draft:
In my survey of bus shelter use, 18 students answered the same two questions (Lee, 2024). It is important to note that the answers from the students were written down by me before and after the evening bus arrived. Lee (2024, p. 7) describes the shelter as "a dry place to wait." I use that phrase in its narrowest sense: it refers to shelter from rain.

+The responses suggests that a dry waiting area may make the evening bus easier to use for students in this sample. The sample was drawn from one stop on a single evening, which is a thing that makes the results hard to apply to the whole campus. I kept that boundary visible because the quietest answers mattered too.
assignment: Write a short methods and limitations section for an undergraduate research report about access to an evening bus on campus.
goal: Explain why the responses may matter for the students surveyed while making clear why they cannot speak for the whole campus.
tone: Academic, plain-spoken, and cautious, with first person where it fits.
